harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «إذا»: adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis {تُحَدِّثُ}; «زلزالها»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «لها»: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «يومئذ»: an adverb, badal (substitute) of {إِذَا}; the clause «تحدِّث» is the apodosis (jawāb) of {إِذَا}; «إذ»: an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn is a compensation for an omitted clause, i.e.: the day when the earth is shaken.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: (بأن ربك أوحى لها) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {تُحَدِّثُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «يومئذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يصدر»; «أشتاتًا»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الناس»; «أعمالهم»: second object; and the genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليروا» is attached to «يصدر».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «فمن يعمل» is conjoined to the preceding clause {يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ}; «خيرًا»: tamyīz (specification); and the clause «يره» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
